item.description: Trump said he is not satisfied with Iran's new proposal sent through Pakistan. Trump administration says its war in Iran has been ’terminated’ before 60-day deadline. Trump says 'not satisfied' with new Iran proposal sent through Pakistan.

item.description: Neel Kashkari said rate hikes may be needed if inflation surges. This is due to the Middle East conflict. The Minneapolis Fed president, Neel Kashkari, said a series of rate increases “could be warranted” if inflation worsens due to the Middle East conflict.

item.title: Trump announces 25% tariffs on EU cars, trucks: ‘Not complying with our fully agreed to trade deal’
item.description: Trump announced 25% tariffs on EU cars and trucks. He cited non-compliance with a trade deal. Trump announces 25% tariffs on EU cars, trucks: ‘Not complying with our fully agreed to trade deal’.

item.title: Iran submits fresh proposal to US as Hormuz crisis roils oil markets, raises hopes for talks
item.description: Iranian officials submitted a new proposal to the US via Pakistan, amid ongoing tensions over the Hormuz crisis and oil market volatility. The development raises hopes for renewed talks between the two nations.

item.title: Iran offers new proposal via Pakistan amid stalled talks
item.description: Iran offered a new proposal to the US through Pakistan, as stalled negotiations continue. IRGC leaders warned that their Navy would use advanced targeting systems to counter potential US strikes.

item.title: Turkish police arrest more than 500 people at May Day rallies
item.description: Turkish police arrested over 500 people during May Day rallies, as authorities deployed significant forces to control the demonstrations. The annual marches, led by workers and unions, are a regular occurrence in Turkey.

item.title: Iran FA president says he was allowed to enter Canada but chose to turn back
item.description: Iran's FA president said he was allowed to enter Canada but chose not to, despite initial reports suggesting he was denied entry. Iran FA president says he was allowed to enter Canada but chose to turn back.

item.title: Turkish police fire tear gas, arrest hundreds at May Day rally
item.description: Turkish police fired tear gas and arrested hundreds at Istanbul's Taksim Square during a May Day rally, as authorities cracked down on the demonstrations. Turkish authorities violently crackdown on May Day demonstrations at Istanbul’s Taksim Square, firing tear gas.

item.title: TMC, BJP lock horns over EVM tampering claims | Above the Fold | 01.05.2026
item.description: The Trinamool Congress and BJP are at odds over allegations of Electronic Voting Machine tampering in West Bengal. The parties exchanged blows over the claims. Tensions are running high. From a political showdown in West Bengal over EVM allegations to rising LPG prices and the Bargi Dam tragedy, here are the top stories of the day.

item.title: Iran Sends New Proposal for Peace Talks with U.S., State Media Says
item.description: Iran has sent a new proposal for peace talks with the US, state media reported. Details of the plan were unclear. President Trump had expressed dissatisfaction with a previous Iranian proposal.

item.title: Pentagon inks deals with AI giants, but not Anthropic
item.description: The Pentagon has signed deals with AI giants OpenAI, Google, and SpaceX. The pacts allow them to bring top-tier AI models onto the US military's secure classified networks. Anthropic was not included.

item.title: Israel Sent UAE Laser Weapon Called 'Iron Beam' That Can Vapourise Iranian Drones
item.description: Israel sent the UAE a laser weapon called Iron Beam to counter Iranian drones. The report stated that the offensive and defensive systems sent to the UAE were mostly prototypes.

item.title: Germany needs no tips from Donald Trump, says Merz's deputy
item.description: Germany's vice chancellor, Lars Klingbeil, said Germany doesn't need advice from Donald Trump on handling the Iran war. Klingbeil criticized Trump's handling of the situation and his role in rising fuel prices.
